items_flat.title_en: OpenAI rolls GPT-6 into ChatGPT with Intelligent UI
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 把 GPT-6 與 Intelligent UI 推進 ChatGPT
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI said on Oct. 7 it is bringing GPT-6 to ChatGPT with Intelligent UI, so answers can mix text, charts, diagrams, buttons, forms, and in-chat tools, and can start before thinking finishes. Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise get GPT-6 Sol today in the Chat tab; Free and Go get GPT-6 Luna starting Oct. 8. Work and Codex models are unchanged, and Pro reasoning still uses GPT-6 Astra without Intelligent UI. The October system card treats both Sol and Luna as High in cybersecurity and biological/chemical domains, not High in AI self-improvement.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 10 月 7 日宣布把 GPT-6 帶進 ChatGPT，並推出 Intelligent UI：回答可混合文字、圖表、圖解、按鈕、表單與對話內工具，且可在思考完成前先開始作答。Plus、Pro、Business、Enterprise 今日在 Chat 分頁使用 GPT-6 Sol；Free 與 Go 從 10 月 8 日起用 GPT-6 Luna。Work 與 Codex 的模型不變，Pro 推理仍用 GPT-6 Astra 且不支援 Intelligent UI。10 月系統卡把 Sol 與 Luna 在網路安全與生化領域標為 High，但未達 AI 自我改進的 High 門檻。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a product rollout of existing GPT-6 tiers, not a new flagship name: the change is interactive answers and earlier partial responses for the weekly ChatGPT base. Safety claims and the High cyber/bio rating are OpenAI’s own assessment; Work and Codex staying on prior snapshots means developers do not get this ChatGPT build by default.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是既有 GPT-6 層級的產品鋪開，不是新的旗艦型號；真正改變的是每週 ChatGPT 用戶得到互動式回答與更早的部分回覆。安全與 High 網路／生化評級來自 OpenAI 自評；Work 與 Codex 仍用先前版本，開發者不會預設拿到這次 ChatGPT 組建。
items_flat.quote: We’re launching GPT-6 to everyone in ChatGPT, across free and paid plans globally.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們正在把 GPT-6 推向 ChatGPT 的所有人，涵蓋全球免費與付費方案。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic launches Claude Haiku 5.5 and cuts Sonnet cache-read prices
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Haiku 5.5，並調降 Sonnet 快取讀取價格
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic on Oct. 7 introduced Claude Haiku 5.5, calling it its cheapest, fastest, and most capable small model, aimed at high-volume work and as a subagent beside Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5. For prompts up to 100k tokens it costs $0.10 / $0.50 per million input/output tokens, about 90% below Haiku 4.5 on that band and about 75% less on average. Anthropic also halved Sonnet 5.5 cache-read prices to $0.10 per million tokens and is adding monthly API credits for Max and Team plans.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 10 月 7 日推出 Claude Haiku 5.5，稱為迄今最便宜、最快、能力最強的小型模型，定位高流量工作，並可作為 Opus 5.5 與 Sonnet 5.5 的子代理。10 萬 token 以內提示詞為每百萬輸入／輸出 $0.10／$0.50，該區間約比 Haiku 4.5 低 90%，平均約便宜 75%。同日把 Sonnet 5.5 快取讀取價減半至每百萬 $0.10，並將為 Max 與 Team 方案提供每月 API 額度。
items_flat.analysis_en: The pricing move matters more than the small-model label: Anthropic is pushing volume work onto Haiku while making Sonnet agent loops cheaper. Its benchmark edges over GPT-6 Luna are Anthropic’s own runs, and Fast Mode on Opus can still be quicker than Haiku at standard speed.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 價格比「小模型」標籤更關鍵：Anthropic 把大量工作推向 Haiku，同時讓 Sonnet 代理迴圈更便宜。相對 GPT-6 Luna 的領先是自家評測，且 Opus 的 Fast Mode 仍可能比標準速度的 Haiku 更快。
items_flat.quote: Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5: the cheapest, fastest, and most capable small model we’ve ever released.
items_flat.quote_zh: 介紹 Claude Haiku 5.5：我們發布過最便宜、最快、能力最強的小型模型。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI publishes math results from an unreleased internal model
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 公開未發布內部模型的數學結果
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI said on Oct. 6 it is releasing a broad set of new mathematical results produced by an internal frontier model, published on GitHub with revision and citation protocols and Lean formalizations of many proofs. It said the average result used roughly three hours of ChatGPT Pro-equivalent thinking, and that it is also sharing reasoning summaries and problem-attempt statistics. The model itself is not named or released.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 10 月 6 日表示，正發布一套由內部前沿模型產出的新數學結果，放在 GitHub，並附修訂與引用規範，以及多項證明的 Lean 形式化。公司稱平均每項結果約等同 ChatGPT Pro 三小時思考，並公開推理摘要與嘗試題數統計。模型本身未命名、也未釋出。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a disclosure of results, not a model launch: verification still depends on Lean coverage and community review, and OpenAI itself says unreleased capability is being held back while papers may still need better exposition.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是結果揭露，不是模型發布：能否核實仍取決於 Lean 覆蓋與社群審查，OpenAI 也承認能力尚未放出，論文闡述仍可能不足。
items_flat.quote: We’re releasing a broad range of new mathematical results produced by an internal frontier model.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們正在發布一套由內部前沿模型產出的新數學結果。

items_flat.title_en: Biohub, DOE, NIH, DeepMind, and Meta commit $1.8B to AI-ready biology data
items_flat.title_zh: Biohub、能源部、NIH、DeepMind 與 Meta 投入 18 億美元建 AI 生物資料
items_flat.summary_en: Biohub said on Oct. 7 that it, the U.S. Department of Energy, NIH, and new partners are putting $1.8 billion into funding, data, compute, and measurement tech for open datasets meant to train predictive biology models. Google DeepMind, Isomorphic Labs, and Meta are collectively investing $300 million; DOE’s share is more than $500 million over five years. Commercial funders get about a year of head start before Biohub opens the data.
items_flat.summary_zh: Biohub 10 月 7 日宣布，與美國能源部、NIH 及新夥伴共投入 18 億美元，涵蓋資金、資料、算力與量測技術，用以產生可供預測性生物模型訓練的開放資料集。Google DeepMind、Isomorphic Labs 與 Meta 合計投入 3 億美元；能源部五年內超過 5 億美元。商業出資方在資料開放前約有一年領先。
items_flat.analysis_en: The useful output is data, not a model launch, and the one-year commercial window means “open” is delayed. Whether a virtual-cell model appears inside five years is a goal, not a delivered result.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 真正交付的是資料，不是模型；一年商業領先期代表「開放」會延後。五年內做出虛擬細胞模型是目標，不是已完成的結果。
items_flat.quote: Together, the organizations are investing $1.8 billion in funding, data, computation, and new measurement technology, the largest coordinated commitment to generating AI-ready biological data to date.
items_flat.quote_zh: 這些機構合計投入 18 億美元於資金、資料、計算與新量測技術，是迄今針對 AI 可用生物資料最大規模的協調承諾。

items_flat.title_en: Mistral opens a public preview of Mistral Large 4, ‘Le Chonk’
items_flat.title_zh: Mistral 公開預覽 Mistral Large 4「Le Chonk」
items_flat.summary_en: Mistral launched a public preview of Mistral Large 4 on Oct. 6: a natively multimodal model with 1 trillion parameters and 52 billion active, trained from scratch on 3,800 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs in its European data centers. Weights are promised by the end of the month; the preview API is on Mistral Studio now.
items_flat.summary_zh: Mistral 10 月 6 日公開預覽 Mistral Large 4：原生多模態、1 兆參數、520 億活躍參數，在歐洲自有資料中心以 3,800 顆 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPU 從零訓練。權重預計月底釋出；預覽 API 已可在 Mistral Studio 使用。
items_flat.analysis_en: The sovereignty pitch is concrete—European training and a promised open-weight drop—but the weights are not out, and several headline cyber scores reflect refusals by closed models rather than a settled ranking.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 主權敘事具體：歐洲訓練且承諾開源權重，但權重尚未釋出；部分網路安全高分來自封閉模型拒答，不能直接當成定論排名。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re launching a public preview of Mistral Large 4.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們推出 Mistral Large 4 的公開預覽。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic expands its Cyber Verification Program into three tiers
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 把網路驗證計畫擴成三級
items_flat.summary_en: On Oct. 6 Anthropic launched an expanded Cyber Verification Program that gives qualifying security professionals advanced cyber capabilities and reduced blocking classifiers. The program now has three access tiers and includes Claude Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Mythos 5.1, and future models, with access still tied to verification and operational scope.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 10 月 6 日推出擴充版網路驗證計畫，讓符合資格的安全專業人員使用進階網路能力並降低阻擋分類器。計畫分為三級，涵蓋 Claude Opus 5.5、Sonnet 5.5、Mythos 5.1 與後續模型，仍須通過驗證並受作業範圍限制。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is gated defender access, not a public jailbreak of safeguards. The practical effect depends on who qualifies and how often reduced classifiers still block legitimate testing.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是有門檻的防禦方存取，不是公開拆除防護。實際效果取決於誰能通過資格，以及降低後的分類器仍多常擋住合法測試。
items_flat.quote: We’re launching a new, expanded version of our Cyber Verification Program, which makes advanced cyber capabilities and reduced blocking classifiers available to qualifying security professionals.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們推出擴充版網路驗證計畫，讓符合資格的安全專業人員使用進階網路能力與降低後的阻擋分類器。

items_flat.title_en: Google opens SynthID Detector to everyone
items_flat.title_zh: Google 向所有人開放 SynthID Detector
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind said on Oct. 7 that SynthID Detector is now available globally in English, expanding a tool previously aimed at media professionals. Users can check image, video, or audio for SynthID watermarks from Google and partners including OpenAI, NVIDIA, Kakao, and soon Apple. Google said it has watermarked over 180 billion images and videos and 240,000 years of audio since 2023.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 10 月 7 日表示，SynthID Detector 現已全球以英文開放，從原先面向媒體專業人士擴大到所有人。使用者可檢查影像、影片或音訊是否含 Google 及合作夥伴（含 OpenAI、NVIDIA、Kakao，即將含 Apple）的 SynthID 浮水印。Google 稱自 2023 年起已標記逾 1,800 億張影像與影片，以及 24 萬年音訊。
items_flat.analysis_en: Public detection only works on content that participating labs actually watermarked, so absence of a mark is not proof of human authorship. Cross-lab coverage is the useful change; login still limits bulk checking.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 公開偵測只對參與實驗室實際打過浮水印的內容有效，沒有標記不代表是人類創作。跨實驗室覆蓋才是實質變化，登入仍限制大量檢查。
items_flat.quote: Now, we’re expanding access to everyone – with the tool available globally in English starting today.
items_flat.quote_zh: 現在我們把存取擴大到所有人——工具即日起全球以英文提供。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI previews College Planner inside ChatGPT for Teens
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 預告 ChatGPT 青少年版的大學規劃工具
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI on Oct. 7 shared progress on ChatGPT for Teens, the default experience for accounts identified as under 18, and previewed College Planner for U.S. high-school students planning a four-year college. It said teens with the experience sent about 2.7 million more learning-related messages on average than those without it, and that College Planner will gather application requirements, deadlines, tasks, and financial-aid steps. The planner is described as coming soon, not generally available.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 10 月 7 日說明 ChatGPT 青少年版進展（系統判定未滿 18 歲即預設套用），並預告給計畫讀四年制大學的美國高中生的 College Planner。公司稱有此體驗的青少年，學習相關訊息平均多約 270 萬則；College Planner 將彙整申請條件、截止日期、任務與助學步驟。該工具標為即將推出，尚未全面開放。
items_flat.analysis_en: The usage figures are OpenAI’s comparison, not an independent study of learning outcomes. The product change that matters is a U.S.-only planning surface still listed as coming soon, on top of age-gated defaults that already shipped.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 使用量是 OpenAI 自己的對照，不是獨立學習成效研究。實質產品變化是仍標「即將推出」的美國限定規劃介面，疊在已上線的年齡預設體驗上。
items_flat.quote: College Planner is coming to ChatGPT for teens, alongside a new teen AI council and more tools for learning.
items_flat.quote_zh: College Planner 將進入 ChatGPT 青少年版，同時還有新的青少年 AI 委員會與更多學習工具。

items_flat.title_en: Google releases EmbeddingGemma 2 as an open multimodal embedder
items_flat.title_zh: Google 釋出開放多模態嵌入模型 EmbeddingGemma 2
items_flat.summary_en: Google on Oct. 6 launched EmbeddingGemma 2, a 740-million-parameter open model under Apache 2.0, built on the Gemma 4 architecture. It maps text, code, images, video, and audio into one embedding space for on-device retrieval. Google said it leads sub-1B multimodal embedders on its cited MTEB Code and MAEB scores, and reported a 9.92-point gain on MTEB Code versus EmbeddingGemma.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google 10 月 6 日推出 EmbeddingGemma 2：7.4 億參數、Apache 2.0、基於 Gemma 4 架構。它把文字、程式碼、影像、影片與音訊映到同一嵌入空間，供裝置端檢索。Google 稱在其引用的 MTEB Code 與 MAEB 上領先 10 億參數以下的多模態嵌入模型，並稱 MTEB Code 較前代提升 9.92 分。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a small open embedder, not a frontier chat model. Its value is local multimodal search; the size-class leader claim is Google’s, not an independent leaderboard result.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是小型開放嵌入模型，不是前沿對話模型。價值在本地多模態搜尋；同級領先是 Google 的說法，不是獨立榜單結果。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re launching EmbeddingGemma 2, expanding beyond text to unify code, images, video, and audio in a shared embedding space.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們推出 EmbeddingGemma 2，從文字擴展到在同一嵌入空間整合程式碼、影像、影片與音訊。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI details computer-use research with Ironclad
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 說明與 Ironclad 的電腦操作研究
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI said on Oct. 6 that a research collaboration with contracting firm Ironclad is being used to train and evaluate agents on professional computer-use tasks. It said GPT-6 Astra is the first frontier model trained on those tasks, scoring 55.0% versus 41.6% for GPT-5.6 Sol on 11 internal tasks, with estimated time per attempt falling from 37.0 to 19.2 minutes.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 10 月 6 日表示，正與合約公司 Ironclad 合作，訓練並評估代理在專業電腦操作任務上的表現。公司稱 GPT-6 Astra 是第一個在這些任務上訓練的前沿模型，11 項內部任務平均 55.0%，高於 GPT-5.6 Sol 的 41.6%，每次嘗試估計時間從 37.0 分鐘降到 19.2 分鐘。
items_flat.analysis_en: The numbers are an internal research eval, not a public benchmark. They show OpenAI treating contract workflows as training signal for computer use, not a new product launch.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這些數字是內部研究評測，不是公開基準。它顯示 OpenAI 把合約流程當電腦操作的訓練訊號，不是新產品發布。
items_flat.quote: GPT‑6 Astra is our first frontier model trained on Ironclad tasks.
items_flat.quote_zh: GPT-6 Astra 是我們第一個在 Ironclad 任務上訓練的前沿模型。

openai.summary_en: OpenAI said on Oct. 6 that a research collaboration with contracting firm Ironclad is being used to train and evaluate agents on professional computer-use tasks. It said GPT-6 Astra is the first frontier model trained on those tasks, scoring 55.0% versus 41.6% for GPT-5.6 Sol on 11 internal tasks, with estimated time per attempt falling from 37.0 to 19.2 minutes.
openai.summary_zh: OpenAI 10 月 6 日表示，正與合約公司 Ironclad 合作，訓練並評估代理在專業電腦操作任務上的表現。公司稱 GPT-6 Astra 是第一個在這些任務上訓練的前沿模型，11 項內部任務平均 55.0%，高於 GPT-5.6 Sol 的 41.6%，每次嘗試估計時間從 37.0 分鐘降到 19.2 分鐘。
openai.analysis_en: The numbers are an internal research eval, not a public benchmark. They show OpenAI treating contract workflows as training signal for computer use, not a new product launch.
openai.analysis_zh: 這些數字是內部研究評測，不是公開基準。它顯示 OpenAI 把合約流程當電腦操作的訓練訊號，不是新產品發布。
openai.quote: GPT‑6 Astra is our first frontier model trained on Ironclad tasks.
openai.quote_zh: GPT-6 Astra 是我們第一個在 Ironclad 任務上訓練的前沿模型。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic launches Claude Haiku 5.5 and cuts Sonnet cache-read prices
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Haiku 5.5，並調降 Sonnet 快取讀取價格
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic on Oct. 7 introduced Claude Haiku 5.5, calling it its cheapest, fastest, and most capable small model, aimed at high-volume work and as a subagent beside Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5. For prompts up to 100k tokens it costs $0.10 / $0.50 per million input/output tokens, about 90% below Haiku 4.5 on that band and about 75% less on average. Anthropic also halved Sonnet 5.5 cache-read prices to $0.10 per million tokens and is adding monthly API credits for Max and Team plans.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic 10 月 7 日推出 Claude Haiku 5.5，稱為迄今最便宜、最快、能力最強的小型模型，定位高流量工作，並可作為 Opus 5.5 與 Sonnet 5.5 的子代理。10 萬 token 以內提示詞為每百萬輸入／輸出 $0.10／$0.50，該區間約比 Haiku 4.5 低 90%，平均約便宜 75%。同日把 Sonnet 5.5 快取讀取價減半至每百萬 $0.10，並將為 Max 與 Team 方案提供每月 API 額度。
anthropic.analysis_en: The pricing move matters more than the small-model label: Anthropic is pushing volume work onto Haiku while making Sonnet agent loops cheaper. Its benchmark edges over GPT-6 Luna are Anthropic’s own runs, and Fast Mode on Opus can still be quicker than Haiku at standard speed.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 價格比「小模型」標籤更關鍵：Anthropic 把大量工作推向 Haiku，同時讓 Sonnet 代理迴圈更便宜。相對 GPT-6 Luna 的領先是自家評測，且 Opus 的 Fast Mode 仍可能比標準速度的 Haiku 更快。
anthropic.quote: Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5: the cheapest, fastest, and most capable small model we’ve ever released.
anthropic.quote_zh: 介紹 Claude Haiku 5.5：我們發布過最便宜、最快、能力最強的小型模型。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic expands its Cyber Verification Program into three tiers
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic 把網路驗證計畫擴成三級
anthropic.summary_en: On Oct. 6 Anthropic launched an expanded Cyber Verification Program that gives qualifying security professionals advanced cyber capabilities and reduced blocking classifiers. The program now has three access tiers and includes Claude Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Mythos 5.1, and future models, with access still tied to verification and operational scope.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic 10 月 6 日推出擴充版網路驗證計畫，讓符合資格的安全專業人員使用進階網路能力並降低阻擋分類器。計畫分為三級，涵蓋 Claude Opus 5.5、Sonnet 5.5、Mythos 5.1 與後續模型，仍須通過驗證並受作業範圍限制。
anthropic.analysis_en: This is gated defender access, not a public jailbreak of safeguards. The practical effect depends on who qualifies and how often reduced classifiers still block legitimate testing.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 這是有門檻的防禦方存取，不是公開拆除防護。實際效果取決於誰能通過資格，以及降低後的分類器仍多常擋住合法測試。
anthropic.quote: We’re launching a new, expanded version of our Cyber Verification Program, which makes advanced cyber capabilities and reduced blocking classifiers available to qualifying security professionals.
anthropic.quote_zh: 我們推出擴充版網路驗證計畫，讓符合資格的安全專業人員使用進階網路能力與降低後的阻擋分類器。

google.title_en: Google opens SynthID Detector to everyone
google.title_zh: Google 向所有人開放 SynthID Detector
google.summary_en: Google DeepMind said on Oct. 7 that SynthID Detector is now available globally in English, expanding a tool previously aimed at media professionals. Users can check image, video, or audio for SynthID watermarks from Google and partners including OpenAI, NVIDIA, Kakao, and soon Apple. Google said it has watermarked over 180 billion images and videos and 240,000 years of audio since 2023.
google.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 10 月 7 日表示，SynthID Detector 現已全球以英文開放，從原先面向媒體專業人士擴大到所有人。使用者可檢查影像、影片或音訊是否含 Google 及合作夥伴（含 OpenAI、NVIDIA、Kakao，即將含 Apple）的 SynthID 浮水印。Google 稱自 2023 年起已標記逾 1,800 億張影像與影片，以及 24 萬年音訊。
google.analysis_en: Public detection only works on content that participating labs actually watermarked, so absence of a mark is not proof of human authorship. Cross-lab coverage is the useful change; login still limits bulk checking.
google.analysis_zh: 公開偵測只對參與實驗室實際打過浮水印的內容有效，沒有標記不代表是人類創作。跨實驗室覆蓋才是實質變化，登入仍限制大量檢查。
google.quote: Now, we’re expanding access to everyone – with the tool available globally in English starting today.
google.quote_zh: 現在我們把存取擴大到所有人——工具即日起全球以英文提供。

google.title_en: Google releases EmbeddingGemma 2 as an open multimodal embedder
google.title_zh: Google 釋出開放多模態嵌入模型 EmbeddingGemma 2
google.summary_en: Google on Oct. 6 launched EmbeddingGemma 2, a 740-million-parameter open model under Apache 2.0, built on the Gemma 4 architecture. It maps text, code, images, video, and audio into one embedding space for on-device retrieval. Google said it leads sub-1B multimodal embedders on its cited MTEB Code and MAEB scores, and reported a 9.92-point gain on MTEB Code versus EmbeddingGemma.
google.summary_zh: Google 10 月 6 日推出 EmbeddingGemma 2：7.4 億參數、Apache 2.0、基於 Gemma 4 架構。它把文字、程式碼、影像、影片與音訊映到同一嵌入空間，供裝置端檢索。Google 稱在其引用的 MTEB Code 與 MAEB 上領先 10 億參數以下的多模態嵌入模型，並稱 MTEB Code 較前代提升 9.92 分。
google.analysis_en: This is a small open embedder, not a frontier chat model. Its value is local multimodal search; the size-class leader claim is Google’s, not an independent leaderboard result.
google.analysis_zh: 這是小型開放嵌入模型，不是前沿對話模型。價值在本地多模態搜尋；同級領先是 Google 的說法，不是獨立榜單結果。
google.quote: Today, we’re launching EmbeddingGemma 2, expanding beyond text to unify code, images, video, and audio in a shared embedding space.
google.quote_zh: 今天我們推出 EmbeddingGemma 2，從文字擴展到在同一嵌入空間整合程式碼、影像、影片與音訊。

frontier_other.title_en: Biohub, DOE, NIH, DeepMind, and Meta commit $1.8B to AI-ready biology data
frontier_other.title_zh: Biohub、能源部、NIH、DeepMind 與 Meta 投入 18 億美元建 AI 生物資料
frontier_other.summary_en: Biohub said on Oct. 7 that it, the U.S. Department of Energy, NIH, and new partners are putting $1.8 billion into funding, data, compute, and measurement tech for open datasets meant to train predictive biology models. Google DeepMind, Isomorphic Labs, and Meta are collectively investing $300 million; DOE’s share is more than $500 million over five years. Commercial funders get about a year of head start before Biohub opens the data.
frontier_other.summary_zh: Biohub 10 月 7 日宣布，與美國能源部、NIH 及新夥伴共投入 18 億美元，涵蓋資金、資料、算力與量測技術，用以產生可供預測性生物模型訓練的開放資料集。Google DeepMind、Isomorphic Labs 與 Meta 合計投入 3 億美元；能源部五年內超過 5 億美元。商業出資方在資料開放前約有一年領先。
frontier_other.analysis_en: The useful output is data, not a model launch, and the one-year commercial window means “open” is delayed. Whether a virtual-cell model appears inside five years is a goal, not a delivered result.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 真正交付的是資料，不是模型；一年商業領先期代表「開放」會延後。五年內做出虛擬細胞模型是目標，不是已完成的結果。
frontier_other.quote: Together, the organizations are investing $1.8 billion in funding, data, computation, and new measurement technology, the largest coordinated commitment to generating AI-ready biological data to date.
frontier_other.quote_zh: 這些機構合計投入 18 億美元於資金、資料、計算與新量測技術，是迄今針對 AI 可用生物資料最大規模的協調承諾。

frontier_other.title_en: Mistral opens a public preview of Mistral Large 4, ‘Le Chonk’
frontier_other.title_zh: Mistral 公開預覽 Mistral Large 4「Le Chonk」
frontier_other.summary_en: Mistral launched a public preview of Mistral Large 4 on Oct. 6: a natively multimodal model with 1 trillion parameters and 52 billion active, trained from scratch on 3,800 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs in its European data centers. Weights are promised by the end of the month; the preview API is on Mistral Studio now.
frontier_other.summary_zh: Mistral 10 月 6 日公開預覽 Mistral Large 4：原生多模態、1 兆參數、520 億活躍參數，在歐洲自有資料中心以 3,800 顆 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPU 從零訓練。權重預計月底釋出；預覽 API 已可在 Mistral Studio 使用。
frontier_other.analysis_en: The sovereignty pitch is concrete—European training and a promised open-weight drop—but the weights are not out, and several headline cyber scores reflect refusals by closed models rather than a settled ranking.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 主權敘事具體：歐洲訓練且承諾開源權重，但權重尚未釋出；部分網路安全高分來自封閉模型拒答，不能直接當成定論排名。
frontier_other.quote: Today, we’re launching a public preview of Mistral Large 4.
frontier_other.quote_zh: 今天我們推出 Mistral Large 4 的公開預覽。

brief_en: OpenAI is rolling GPT-6 Sol and Luna into ChatGPT with Intelligent UI, while Anthropic shipped Haiku 5.5 at a sharp price cut. Same-day picture also includes OpenAI’s math-results drop, public SynthID detection, and a $1.8B Biohub biology-data push with Meta and DeepMind.
brief_zh: OpenAI 向 ChatGPT 推出 GPT-6 與互動介面；Anthropic 發布更便宜的 Haiku 5.5。同日還有數學結果、SynthID 公開偵測，以及 Biohub 生物資料擴張。
